name: UQ Global Experiences Grant
provider: University of Queensland, Student Employability Centre
summary: Automatic travel grant for UQ students accepted into a semester exchange or short-term global experience, prioritising under-represented groups.
key: The maximum grant amount is AUD$2000 for semester exchange; the short-term (global in-person) maximum is AUD$1000.
who: Accepted into a semester exchange or short-term global experience by the Global Experiences Team.
Priority goes to students from under-represented groups.
how: No separate application. Accepted students are automatically considered.
catches: Virtual experiences aren't funded, and you can't hold certain other grants (NCP, Westpac, faculty, host) for the same experience.
You can still take an OS-HELP loan.

extra_sources.label: UQ Employability: Costs and funding for short-term experiences

evidence.quote: The maximum grant amount is AUD$2000
Short-term (global in-person): The maximum grant amount is AUD$1000.
All students who have been accepted into a program supported by the Global Experiences team will be automatically considered for a grant.
